problem_statement: 6LoWPAN SFR must provide a hook for CongURE congestion control. When CongURE support is enabled, a congure_snd_t sender state must be associated with each SFR fragmentation buffer: obtained through gnrc_sixlowpan_frag_sfr_congure_snd_get(), initialized with the fragmentation buffer as its context, visible as fbuf->sfr.congure, and released when the buffer is destroyed. SFR must report fragment sent, discarded, timeout, lost, acknowledged, and ECN events to that state, and must use the state to bound in-flight fragments and inter-frame timing. The tracked fragments must be represented as congure_snd_msg_t entries whose size, send_time, and resends fields SFR maintains. A configuration option CONFIG_GNRC_SIXLOWPAN_SFR_MOCK_ARQ_TIMER must disable automatic ARQ timeout scheduling so an external caller can invoke gnrc_sixlowpan_frag_sfr_arq_timeout() manually. Without CongURE support, SFR must retain its configured-window behavior.
